An autumn event on October 31 (Saturday, Reiwa 6) from 11:00 to 19:00 at Hanno Riverbed Wood Deck Stage Plaza, hosted by Okumusashi Hanno Tourism Association.

Food & Drink: Food trucks featuring Hanno local specialties—craft beer, curry, BBQ, grilled chicken, and more.

Workshops & Activities:
• On-site T-shirt and hoodie printing workshop
• Free activities for children: bamboo boat workshop & races, treasure hunt in a leaf pool (participants receive Halloween stickers and marshmallows)

Atmosphere: A Sweden torch (log fire) creates a magical evening. Live music shifts from daytime nature-themed sets to dramatic evening songs as sunset transitions to night.

What to Bring: Warm layers recommended, as temperatures are expected to drop around sunset and nightfall at the end of October.

Weather: The event will be cancelled in case of rain or severe weather. Cancellation notice will be posted on Instagram and X the day before.

For more details, visit the Okumusashi Hanno Tourism Association website.
summary: 🎪 Hanno Gourmet & Beer Garden in Autumn at Hanno Riverbed
